mcqs.question: Who released the second edition of the novel “Bazaar” by Niranjan Dev Sharma?
options: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu
mcqs.explanation: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu released the second edition of “Bazaar,” a novel by Niranjan Dev Sharma, published by Aadhar Prakashan. Shivraj Singh Chouhan was associated with the book “Apnapan,” not “Bazaar.”
